title: Past Simple і Past Continuous
explanation:
**Past Simple** — завершена дія в минулому (часто з точним часом: *yesterday, last year, in 2020*).

**Past Continuous** — дія, що **тривала** в певний момент минулого, часто як «фон» для іншої, короткої дії.

Схема: *I **was cooking** (фон) when the phone **rang** (коротка дія).*

*while* + Continuous, *when* + Simple — найчастіше поєднання.
formula: Past Simple: V2 / -ed · did + not + V

examples.uk: Ми переїхали до Кракова у 2022 році.

examples.en: I was driving home when it started to rain.
examples.uk: Я їхав додому, коли почався дощ.

examples.en: While she was sleeping, I made breakfast.
examples.uk: Поки вона спала, я приготував сніданок.

examples.en: What were you doing at 9 last night?
examples.uk: Що ти робив учора о 9 вечора?

examples.en: I didn't hear the doorbell — I was having a shower.
examples.uk: Я не почув дзвінка — я був у душі.

examples.en: He lost his phone while he was running.

tip: Неправильні дієслова (go → went, buy → bought) треба просто вивчити — додайте їх у картки.

exercises.prompt: While I ___, I cut my finger.
What ___ you ___ (do) at 8 pm yesterday? (2 слова)
exercises.explanation: Конкретний момент у минулому → Past Continuous.

exercises.prompt: I ___ (not / see) him at the party.
They ___ (buy) a new car last month.

exercises.sentence: I was meet my friend yesterday.
Did you went to the cinema?

answer: When I arrived, they were having dinner.
They were having dinner when I arrived.

exercises.prompt: She read a book. Then the lights went out. (while)
answer: While she was reading a book, the lights went out.
The lights went out while she was reading a book.
I was sleeping when you called.
I was asleep when you called.
